card.name: Linking words before symptom or cause
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as with, to, of, and or such that sit just before an expected symptom, cause or effect, in health explainers and label text. The next word is often a pain or discomfort term.

modes.label: Cause or effect links
modes.description: A short linking word after a condition or cause, just before the effect is named.
modes.example: The condition does not improve<< with>> bed rest.

modes.description: A verb or link word before a description of strain or harm to the body.
